## About
Ajax Exterminating is a locally owned pest control company on El Camino Real in Houston, serving Clear Lake and the towns around it. When you call, you reach local technicians, not a call center.
We treat homes, restaurants, offices and other businesses for ants, roaches, spiders, mice, rats, mosquitos, fleas and flies. Our technicians are state licensed and insured, and we look for where pests are coming from, inside and out, so they stay gone.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 105 Google reviews. One thing to know up front: we don't remove snakes, reptiles, possums, raccoons, squirrels or hogs.

## Services
- Roaches: Household roaches and palmetto bugs, treated with professional-grade products in the places roaches hide.
- Fire ants: We treat your whole yard, flower beds included. If fire ants show up during the season, we come back and treat them again for free.
- Rats and mice: We find where rats and mice are getting in and where they're active, then protect your home or business against them.
- Spider control: We inspect for spiders and clear them from inside your house and around the yard.
- Backyard mosquito control: We inspect for breeding spots and treat the parts of the yard where your family spends time outdoors.
- Flea control: We build a treatment plan around your home, targeting the carpets, furniture and pet spots where fleas hide.
- Fly control: For homes and businesses alike, we go after where flies are breeding, not just the ones you can see.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Clear Lake, League City, Seabrook, Kemah, Webster and the surrounding areas.

Q: Do I have to sign a contract?
A: No. You don't need a contract to get started.

Q: Can I get a single treatment, or do you offer regular service?
A: Both. We offer one-time, monthly or quarterly service.

Q: Do you remove snakes or wildlife?
A: No. We don't remove snakes or other reptiles, possums, raccoons, squirrels or hogs.
